title: Stat layout data
description: Big number hero. One dominant tabular numeral (~300px), unit line, explanation paragraph.

label.description: Small caps context line (e.g. 'Q1 2026 · measured across 47 tickets').

value.description: The hero number. Keep short: '10×', '47%', '3 wks', '$2M', etc.

unit.description: What the number measures ('faster delivery cycles', 'fewer bugs', etc.).

source.description: Optional methodology / source line. Defaults to 'Kolya · AI-Native PM'.
